reviews.t: Life Changing...Questioning all life decisions prior to this moment.
reviews.x: I love this makeup brush cleaner. Its making me wonder how I lived life prior to this seriously.... Its so easy! Just sprinkle some soap on the mat and rub your brush onto the mat...whoever invented this may deserve a Nobel Peace Prize. Top Inventions/Discoveries: 1. Man discovers fire. 2. Someone sliced that loaf of bread up and threw some meat and cheese in between it and VIOLA! The sandwich was invented. 3. Tampons 4. WiFi 5. Electric Wine bottle opener 6. KEDSUM Makeup Brush Cleaning Mat

reviews.t: Great product!
reviews.x: This works great! I am really happy with this purchase. It exceeded me expectations. Super effective at cleaning makeup brushes. I used the sigmagic brush shampoo and qgakago makeup brush drying rack to complete this process.

reviews.t: I love this! At first
reviews.x: I love this! At first, I thought the suctions on the bottom of the mat will be a problem but as soon as I started washing my makeup brushes, they weren't a problem at all. Got all my brushes clean in no time.

I have a TON of brushes and it was nice to be able to swirl multiples at a time instead of individually. I didn't use the designated sections like the mat has written on it but I still was impressed by how I got even my stubborn foundation and blush brush clean (using coconut oil and dawn as a cleanser). I would definitely recommend this to others. My

reviews.t: Perfect to clean all my makeup brushes
reviews.x: Perfect to clean all my makeup brushes. I used to use one of those Sigma Spa gloves but this is so much easier since it just sticks to the bottom of my sink and both my hands are free. The smaller heart shaped one is also nice I guess more of eye brushes or maybe if you're traveling. The sponge is bad not gonna lie it's stiff and doesn't absorb water at all but I don't really care since I got it only for the mat

reviews.t: It looks like it will work well and it feels soooo soft
reviews.x: I have Amazon prime, and this arrived in 2 days. It looks like it will work well and it feels soooo soft. Attached are pictures with a ruler for scale

reviews.t: but I was hesitant to buy something that just seemed like an unnecessary trendy item
reviews.x: My brushes have never been cleaner! I've always had trouble getting foundation out of my very expensive face brush, but this mat got it squeaky clean in about a minute. I've been seeing this all over instagram and blogs, but I was hesitant to buy something that just seemed like an unnecessary trendy item. However, this is one of the best purchases I've ever made for my makeup. Cleaning brushes with this mat is fun instead of being tedious. I wish I had bought one sooner.

reviews.t: I don't know about this
reviews.x: Okay, so I give this product 3 stars because it smells... like it could be carcinogenic. Just not a good smell, and the sponge it comes with has such an intense synthetic chemical smell. I terms of how effective they are in cleaning your brushes, I would say they do seem to get my brushes cleaner than just using your hands, but it could be better. I still see makeup in some of my brushes, especially the white ones.

reviews.t: Great product, TERRIBLE smell
reviews.x: Product came exactly as pictured, but the only reason I'm giving this 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the AWFUL smell when I opened the package. The brush mat and glove smell very chemical, I had to throw them in the dishwasher on a heavy wash before I even would dream of putting any of my brushes near it. If the smell disappears after the wash however, I will be incredibly satisfied

reviews.t: More than what I wanted. I use the small ...
reviews.x: More than what I wanted. I use the small mat for cleaning my brushes. I don't think I'll use the large mat unless I'm cleaning brushes with friends or I lose the small one lol...the small one does the job for me. The makeup sponge blender isn't as soft as the beauty blender. I may never use it.

reviews.t: Great!
reviews.x: Best way to keep makeup brushes clean is to use a mat and baby shampoo. This mat is very affordable and does exactly what you need it to do! I also love the little travel sized one they give you. The back of the large one also has suction cups for added convenience. Good product!

reviews.t: Three Stars
reviews.x: It cleans well but the mitten is more convenient.

I considered ordering one from sigma but just couldn’t justify the price. The quality is great and it still looks as good as the day I got it. The makeup sponge that comes with the set is terrible so I just gave it to my daughter to add to her pretend makeup. The smaller hea

reviews.x: Love the suction cups on the bottom bc I can stick it to my sink while I wash brushes. Easy to use and effective and getting literally EVERYTHING loose. I used for all my brushes as soon as I got it and some of them were caked (ew I know)- but with a little soap/shampoo and the grooves in this mat, all of them were thoroughly cleaned. reviews.t: BETTER THAN SIGMA!
reviews.x: SO happy I bought this! I believe Sigma is the original inventor of this type of product that’s shaped to fit your sink but honestly, who would by Sigma for $25 retail when you can get this? It’s the same exact thing only a better price. I love all the sections for different brushes and how quick the clean is. It even comes with a little travel sized one that I take with me on trips. The mat gets your brush clean deeper than just a surface clean if you were to use your palm like I was. Highly re

reviews.t: Sink mat is great
reviews.x: This review is for the sink mat portion since the sponge is way too hard for me to ever use and I don't use the hand held. If you have very long fingernails, the hand-held is not going to be comfortable but you could probably guess that if you have eyes.  Sink mat worked great, easy to clean. Cleaned my brushes super quickly. Stuck to my sink in my irritatingly rounded sink bowl so I appreciated that. It's a little flimsy but like... it's 10 bucks so I wasn't expecting titanium. Serves my needs.

reviews.t: Don't spend Dept. Store prices on the same item!
reviews.x: Super excited to get this, I had been looking at a much more expensive version at a high end retailer and decided I'd check Amazon to see if I could find something comparable. This version is exactly the same as the higher end, more expensive version and works great! My brushes are super clean when I'm done and the product itself is very sturdy and well made. I would definitely suggest someone to purchase this before spending more than 2x's as much on the "high end" version.

reviews.t: Good for the price
reviews.x: This mat is great for cleaning brushes. I clean my makeup brushes with baby shampoo and I used to just clean the brushes on my hand. This mat allows me to more thoroughly clean my makeup brushes, especially the more dense ones. The textures are great at cleaning out all the makeup but also at getting all the soap of the brush.  I haven't used the heart shaped cleaner. It came with a blender but it smelled bad and was too solid so I just threw it out

reviews.t: Great bargin, great quality.
reviews.x: High quality silicone with a velvety feel.  The bigger pad is great if you need to clean a whole bunch of brushes at once or just face brushes.  I love the heart shape for the hand-held cleaning pad. It's perfect for when you only need to clean a couple of eye brushes.  I haven't tried the sponge but it does feel very soft and thick and will probably work like any other beauty blender.  Very satisfied with this purchase and definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Don’t recommend for foundation or long length brush hairs
reviews.x: *changed rating to 5 stars from 3- the customer service department reached out almost immediately to address my comment below, which wasn’t too negative in my opinion, but the fact they addressed my concern left me floored. I would do business with this store again.  Really doesn’t get inside the brush where all the makeup is caked in. Don’t recommend for foundation or long length brush hairs. It’s ok to clean the surface of smaller brushes.

reviews.t: Amazing product!
reviews.x: This is one of the best purchases I've ever made! It makes cleaning my brushes a fun task that I enjoy, it's on par with a kid playing with a Playdoh factory, haha. Not only is this wonderful for regular use with my daily brushes, but the little handheld scrubber is SO USEFUL when I'm doing costume makeup (read: facepaint) and need to quickly clean my brush without soap when switching colors! Love love love love love it!

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the mat cleans makeup brushes effectively and quickly, including stubborn foundation.
Several reviewers praise the suction cups that hold the mat in place and free up both hands.
A recurring complaint is a strong chemical or synthetic smell when opening the package.
Some reviewers note the mat is smaller than expected or that the small mat alone is sufficient.
A few reviewers find the included sponge or mitten less useful or less convenient than the mat itself.
